A '''flanth steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]]. It could be broiled, and specialized [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] called [[flanth-house]]s sold flanth steaks and accompanying [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] such as [[balka greens]] and [[giviots]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
